summary: Clearwater NF log cabin site on Vanderbilt Hill, Shoshone County: abandoned 1941; sources differ on whether the cabin dates from 1930 or 1934. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1941. Sources describe what was left as ruins; none describes the site today.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts classes the site as hike-in.

events.note: log cabin; the Forest Service 2016 list gives 1934 for the cabin
camp set up on the ridge north of the summit

evidence.supports: about 13 miles southeast of Red Ives Ranger Station
evidence.quote: 13 miles southeast of Red Ives R.S.

evidence.supports: 1930 log cabin (ruins); 1934 camp on ridge north of summit; abandoned 1941
evidence.quote: 1930: log cabin (ruins). 1934: camp atop ridge north of summit. Abandoned 1941.

evidence.supports: 1934 camp atop ridge north of summit
evidence.quote: Camp atop ridge north of summit

evidence.supports: Forest Service list: log cabin dated 1934, abandoned 1941 (ruins)
association list marks the site gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The association and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 1930 for the log cabin and 1934 for a camp on the ridge north of the summit. The Forest Service 2016 list gives 1934 for the log cabin. The list does not explain the difference, so the story reports both dates.

notes_for_editor: The record's county (Shoshone) and ground kind match the association's list and need no correction. The Forest Lookouts Shoshone County page lists Vanderbilt Hill with a township only and no history, so it is not cited. The one web search found no further history. No source gives access or the site's condition today, so access level is unset. No photos were found; the Forest Service list records none for this site.
